observations.behavior: Adds four new endpoint configurations for Lever's nested resources: applications, offers, interviews, feedback, alongside an existing postings endpoint. P1.F4.H4.
observations.posthog_connection: These endpoints support fetching nested opportunity-related records (applications, offers, interviews, feedback) from the Lever warehouse connector, expanding parent-child relationships and including nested rows. This could enable warehouse users to import complete opportunity hierarchies rather than just top-level postings.
